subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh one of the linked fork candidates or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-backed, but the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr/linked-pr-open and the linked fork closing PRs are not merged, so automation should pause until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix in this repository, using the closed PRs as context and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Pick the stronger linked fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage and live behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue open without another automated branch until a contributor refreshes a candidate with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix in this repository, using the closed PRs as context and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent Feishu send-path work make this the strongest available owner for choosing the implementation path.
